QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Flushing Out the Featherweights
QuestInfo.0: Start doing important public safety work with Lita, NLC's sheriff.
QuestInfo.1: Sheriff Lita asks you to get rid of Street Slime monsters, which have been causing minor damage to the city. Take them out before they can move up to causing more trouble.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Street Slime monsters, helping take the pressure off Lita.

mob.0: If you go out to the East side of the city, you'll see those slimes. That means it's time to take out about 200 or so.
